mechanism: Reset a familiar viewpoint and scale anchor in each vignette, introduce one impossible airborne form that preserves readable silhouette, vary observer distance and occlusion, then escalate proximity until the final viewpoint encounter feels immediate rather than merely larger.

invariants.rule: Give each vignette an immediately familiar scale anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: A blank sky provides no scale proof.

invariants.rule: Use one dominant impossible silhouette per vignette.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several equal forms create visual noise.

invariants.rule: Change observer carrier or occlusion between vignettes.
Increase proximity, not just nominal size.
invariants.purpose: Creates a real escalation toward encounter.

invariants.rule: End with a viewpoint-level encounter that preserves spatial legibility.
invariants.ablation_failure: An abstract final close-up loses the observer relationship.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source giant whale, manta, nautilus, jellyfish and shark
Shanghai skyline, airplane window, highway and car POV
the exact animal order and city landmarks

instantiations.concept: Five original airborne seed structures appear over a coastal wind farm, train window, quarry road, public greenhouse and maintenance rover; each new anchor shortens distance until a translucent seed sail crosses directly over the rover canopy.
